name: La Roda (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of La Roda (a castle and a wheel on red within a border inscribed MUY NOBLE Y MUY LEAL VILLA DE LA RODA).
history: Municipal flag of La Roda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Roda arms — castle and wheel on red with inscribed border
